Notes: io_ctrl defaults to 1 (input mode). data_in reflects pin level.

5. Compare read vs expected.
6. Repeat for patterns 0xAAAAAAAA 0x55555555 0xF5F5F5F5 0xA5A5A5A5 0xFFFF0000.
Expected_Result: Read data matches computed expected value for each pattern
Notes: Write_mask=0x003F0000; Read_mask=0x003E0002. WO field intr_clr not readable.

TestCase_Description: Verify level-high interrupt generation for GPIO pins 8-39
Pre_Conditions: GIC IRQ 87 enabled via GIC_EnableIRQ(87). Sysreg interrupt enabled via write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR).
Test_Steps:
1. For each GPIO pad i (0 to 31):
  a. Write 0x00180000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) to set input mode (bit20=1) and level_sel=1 (bit19=1).
  b. Enable group interrupt: write (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1.
  c. Write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM (0xA0243ffc) to drive pin high.
  d. Wait for IRQ handler.
  e. In IRQ handler: read GPIO reg and check intr_raw_sts (bit1) is set.
  f. Verify group interrupt status bit is set in MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1.
  g. Clear interrupt by writing 0x00110000 to GPIO reg.
  h. Verify interrupt cleared.
Expected_Result: Interrupt raw status bit set for active-high level. Group interrupt status bit set. Interrupt cleared successfully after writing intr_clr.
Pass_Criteria: All 32 GPIO pads generate level-high interrupt and clear correctly
Notes: Uses #define GPIO0 1. GIC IRQ=87. level_sel=1 means interrupt on level 1.

TestCase_Description: Verify level-low interrupt generation for GPIO pins 8-39
Pre_Conditions: GIC IRQ 87 enabled. Sysreg interrupt enabled.
Test_Steps:
1. For each GPIO pad i (0 to 31):
  a. Write 0x00100000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) to set input mode (bit20=1) and level_sel=0 (bit19=0).
  b. Enable group interrupt: write (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1.
  c. Write ~(1<<i) to SRAM (0xA0243ffc) to drive pin low.
  d. Wait for IRQ handler.
  e. In IRQ handler: verify intr_raw_sts and group status.
  f. Clear interrupt.
Expected_Result: Interrupt raw status bit set for active-low level. Group interrupt status bit set. Interrupt cleared successfully.
Pass_Criteria: All 32 GPIO pads generate level-low interrupt and clear correctly
Notes: level_sel=0 means interrupt on level 0.

TestCase_Description: Verify interrupt raw status is cleared by writing 1 to intr_clr field
Pre_Conditions: Interrupt has been triggered on a GPIO pad.
Test_Steps:
1. Trigger an interrupt on GPIO pad (e.g. level-high).
2. Read GPIO register and confirm intr_raw_sts (bit 1) is set.
3. Write 0x00110000 to GPIO register (bit 16 = 1 for intr_clr).
4. Wait 20 cycles.
5. Read GPIO register again.
6. Verify intr_raw_sts (bit 1) is cleared and read value is 0x100001.
Expected_Result: After writing intr_clr=1 the intr_raw_sts bit is cleared. Register reads 0x100001.
Pass_Criteria: Interrupt clear successful; raw status returns to 0
Notes: Writing 1 to intr_clr clears raw status. Writing 0 has no change.

TestCase_Description: Verify group interrupt enable and disable via gp0_intr1_intr_en1
Pre_Conditions: Interrupt triggered on a GPIO pad.
Test_Steps:
1. Write (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 to enable interrupt for pad i.

Expected_Result: Group interrupt status reflects enabled pad. After disable status is 0x0.
Pass_Criteria: Enable/disable of group interrupt works correctly
Notes: Offset 0x84 for enable; 0x88 for status.

TestCase_Description: Verify GIC IRQ 87 is correctly routed for GPIO0 interrupt
Pre_Conditions: GPIO0 macro defined (#define GPIO0 1). System reset applied.
Test_Steps:
1. Call GIC_EnableIRQ(87) to enable IRQ 87.
2. Trigger a GPIO level interrupt.
3. Verify Default_IRQHandler is invoked.
4. In handler verify interrupt source is GPIO.
5. Clear interrupt.
6. Call GIC_ClearIRQ(87).
7. Verify no spurious interrupts.
Expected_Result: IRQ 87 fires when GPIO0 interrupt occurs. Handler is invoked. GIC_ClearIRQ(87) clears the IRQ.
Pass_Criteria: GIC IRQ routing for GPIO0 verified
Notes: GIC_EnableIRQ(87) for GPIO0; GIC_EnableIRQ(88) for GPIO1.
